answer: A bridge-toll stake ladder stops cheap fake agents. First, each new agent locks 50 tokens and one verified device key before it can trade. Second, it earns trust only by completing 20 small, checked jobs over 30 days, with its stake slashed for fraud. Third, crossing to higher-value work requires doubling the stake and a peer review, so a sybil army faces real cost: 1,000 fakes would need 50,000 tokens, 1,000 devices, and a month of honest work. Like a walnut that only cracks after steady pressure, and an ivory tower that admits no one without a key, trust here is grown, not claimed.
